Subject: ACME: Procurement & security next steps / post-demo recap

Hi Alice / Acme procurement team —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and recommended next steps from our side: 

- Demo notes: we covered latency and cost profiles for your 3 workloads; showed predictable throughput on dedicated capacity and the autoscaling behavior for bursty traffic.
- Security/compliance: we are SOC 2 Type II audited (report attached) and we have a standard DPA (attached). If you prefer to use Acme's DPA, happy to review but note our standard DPA is DocuSign-ready.
- Commercial / paper process: Redwood supports both credit-card and Purchase Order (PO) workflows. Typical pattern we see: credit card for pilot/proof-of-concept (fast onboarding), PO + invoicing + net30 for enterprise procurement. We can accept PO and issue invoices once legal completes the order form sign-off.
- Marketplace: we are listed on AWS Marketplace (private listing support available) which can simplify procurement for some customers; we can confirm SKUs and entitlements if you prefer that path.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3.1.pdf, SOC2-report-2026.pdf (stubs attached here).

Proposed next steps: 
1) Please confirm the commercial path you prefer (card pilot vs PO + net terms vs AWS Marketplace).
2) If you want us to start procurement intake, share your vendor questionnaire (or we can start with a short security intake form). Our security team typically turns around questionnaires in 3-5 business days depending on scope.
3) If PO, please share the required billing contact, remit address, and any required vendor IDs (DUNS, tax ID).

Happy to hop on a quick follow-up with Legal/Procurement if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — that aligns with our notes. A few procurement/legal questions before we move forward: 

1) Do you accept a PO with Net30? Any minimums or required contract term?
2) We typically require the vendor to provide current SOC 2 report and an insurer certificate (we'll send the exact requirements).
3) For the DPA: would you prefer we sign Redwood's DPA or send our standard DPA for your legal to review?
4) Is there a Marketplace SKU for ACME to purchase via AWS Marketplace? If so, can you share the SKU and whether purchases via marketplace provide consolidated billing and immediate entitlement?

If you can confirm the PO path and estimated turnaround for the questionnaire/DPA review, we can put this into our Sourcing pipeline this week.

Best,

Hi Alice —

Great questions — answers inline below. I'm also attaching the DPA and SOC 2 report for your packet.

1) PO + Net30: Yes, we accept Purchase Orders and standard Net30 payment terms for enterprise contracts. There are no mandatory minimums for ACME's usage tier; pricing will be per the quoted order form. Legal typically needs to review the order form + PO; turnaround for signature depends on counterparty review but we aim for 5-7 business days on standard orders.

2) SOC 2 / insurance: SOC 2 Type II report attached (SOC2-report-2026.pdf). For insurance, please share the exact certificate requirements and we'll route to our finance team for confirmation.

3) DPA: We can sign either:
   - If you sign our Redwood_DPA_v3.1.pdf (attached) we can push via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/link/XYZ-REDWOOD-DPA
   - If you'd rather have us review Acme's DPA, please send it and I'll loop Legal.

4) Marketplace: We do have an AWS Marketplace listing. Purchasing via AWS Marketplace supports consolidated billing and immediate entitlement in most cases — I'll confirm the exact SKU and whether ACME needs a private listing. Preliminary link: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/B08EXAMPLE. If you go that route, please let us know so we can coordinate the procurement enablement on our side.

Security questionnaire: please share your questionnaire (Word/Excel preferred) or a secure link and we'll have our security team start intake; typical turnaround is 3 business days for standard 30–40 question vendor questionnaires, longer for bespoke requests.

Next steps I suggest: 
- You confirm preferred commercial path (card pilot vs PO vs Marketplace) — we can provision a short trial immediately if you want to run pilot on card.
- If PO, please send remit details and any vendor IDs.
- If security questionnaire, please upload to the secure intake link or forward to me and I'll escalate to Security.

I can also do a 30-minute call with our Legal and Security team if your legal/procurement prefer a live walkthrough.

Thanks —
Marissa
